insight: In butverify, do not run multiple bd commands in parallel: the embedded Dolt backend takes an exclusive lock under .beads/embeddeddolt and concurrent bd reads/writes can fail with 'another process holds the exclusive lock'. Run bd commands serially.

Evidence template polish must keep index.html + styles.css + evidence.js under the 50KB fitness budget; after adding topbar/details UI, run pkg/templates TestRenderEvidenceHTML_BundleUnder50KB and trim CSS/HTML rather than raising the limit.

When evidence topbar controls sit next to a horizontally scrollable metadata strip, give the controls a positioned z-index above the strip; browser QA caught visible theme/metadata buttons that only clicked reliably on their SVG children until .ev-topbar-actions was positioned.

For the evidence viewer carousel, listen to scroll events on .ev-track and use the track bounding rect when computing nearest slides; in carousel mode also clear .ev-slide scroll-margin and use zero gap/scroll-padding, otherwise mobile 320px can show a neighboring slide sliver or desync active pager state after switching layouts.
